name: as_of_month_day with a negative year_offset on the overall rank column
description: year_offset folds into make_date's YEAR argument rather than into an interval added after the clamp, which is what makes the leap-day clamp resolve in the TARGET year. That also puts the offset in raw arithmetic position, so this pins the negative case: single_year_offset spans -30 to 30 on the client, and the emitted `make_date((opening_days.year) + -5, 2, 1)` must be valid SQL rather than a syntax error. Uses 02-29 on a rank column so the fixture also covers the clamp and the two rank metrics, whose IS NOT NULL predicate differs from the value column's.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2020,2025]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tf4c9cb64bb090f94f137a576cbdc1c9b"."overall_rank" AS "player_keeptradecut_overall_rank_0", "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "opening_days" on "opening_days"."year" = "player_years"."year" left join "keeptradecut_valuations" as "tf4c9cb64bb090f94f137a576cbdc1c9b" on "tf4c9cb64bb090f94f137a576cbdc1c9b"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "tf4c9cb64bb090f94f137a576cbdc1c9b"."is_superflex" = true and opening_days.year = (player_years.year) and "tf4c9cb64bb090f94f137a576cbdc1c9b"."observed_at" = (select MAX(observed_at) from "keeptradecut_valuations" where "pid" = player.pid and "is_superflex" = true and "overall_rank" is not null and "observed_at" <= LEAST(LEAST(make_date((opening_days.year) + -5, 2, 1) + (29 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((opening_days.year) + -5, 2, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz, now()) and "observed_at" > (LEAST(LEAST(make_date((opening_days.year) + -5, 2, 1) + (29 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((opening_days.year) + -5, 2, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz, now()) - interval '30 days')) group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tf4c9cb64bb090f94f137a576cbdc1c9b"."overall_rank", "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 10
